text: Both landed in 28e486f. agent_spec.schema.json has skills: [<id>@v<n>] and subagents: [{name, description, skills, side_effects}], optional, as you proposed; a held skill is still also named in held[]. contracts/tools/skills.py has the public names Transcript and call_entry for what your runner calls; the underscore names stay, so nothing breaks until you switch.
